name: Velidreth

abilities.name: Lunging Slash
abilities.description: The boss slashes at its target dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Exsanguinate
abilities.description: Getting hit by Lunging Slash deals minor physical damage over time.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: The boss slashes rapidly at its target dealing moderate physical damage over time.

abilities.name: Corpulence
abilities.description: A charged heavy melee attack that deals high physical damage.

abilities.name: Feast and Famine
abilities.description: The boss pulls a target in and drains their ultimate. Use ultimates when they are ready to counter this.

abilities.name: Shadow Sense
abilities.description: After draining their ultimate, the boss tends to cast Shadow Sense. In this phase, the boss jumps onto the ceiling while saying "That's it! Don't move a muscle.". Players will need to stand still, if not they will take very high magical damage. This attack is lethal on veteran hard mode.

abilities.name: Shadow Spine
abilities.description: After Shadow Sense, the boss jumps back down summoning spikes under each player as indicated by red circles. Quickly roll out of the AOE to avoid the spike. This attack is lethal on veteran hard mode.

abilities.name: Deadly Spores
abilities.description: The boss releases colored spores that roam the arena at random. The color of the spore is determined by the player drained during Feast and Famine, tanks will spawn red orbs, magicka builds will spawn blue, and stamina builds will spawn green orbs. Touching the spores will drain the corresponding resource, so they must be avoided.

abilities.name: Summon Flesh Atronachs
abilities.description: After a moment, the boss summons two flesh atronachs to attack the party. They must be defeated quickly, following which two players should run over to their bodies to use the "Atronach's Light" synergy to pick up their torches. The group must do this before the boss reaches 60% and 30% health as the Banish mechanic is scripted to trigger at those points, and going into the catacombs without the light can be challenging.

abilities.name: Banish
abilities.description: At 60% and 30% health, the boss teleports the group into the catacombs connected to the arena. In normal, all four group members are together on the same side while on veteran the group is split into two pairs. The darkness within the catacombs will snare and damage players unless they stay within the Atronach's Light AOE or if they light the braziers found within. Hoarvors within the catacombs will spawn and attack the group endlessly, and players will need to run back towards the center to escape. Do note that the gates separating the catacombs from the center will be randomly locked, if one path is closed simply try another one.

abilities.name: Deadly Spikes
abilities.description: Spike traps within the catacombs will deal moderate physical damage and snare to players that step on them. The Atronach's Light AOE can reveal which traps are active (glowing red) thus players can avoid them accordingly.

abilities.name: Gout of Bile
abilities.description: If a player attempts to resurrect a dead group member, the boss will channel a spell on them that deals moderate magical damage and stuns them interrupting the rez. Other group members should interrupt the boss so the rez can proceed safely. This only occurs on veteran hard mode.

abilities.name: Summon Shadow Weavers, Shadow Warriors and Marrow Fiends
abilities.description: The boss summons minions to attack the party. They should be killed quickly to simplify the fight. This only occurs on veteran hard mode.

abilities.name: Orb of Spite
abilities.description: The Statue of Mephala at the side of the arena will fire orbs of magic on top of players occasionally dealing high magical damage. Players should block or shield up when targeted to reduce the damage taken. This is especially important during Shadow Sense, as players will be unable to move to avoid the AOE. This attack is only used on veteran hard mode.

abilities.name: Expose Morsel
abilities.description: The boss bites its target lowering their armor and spell resistance momentarily. This is only used on veteran hard mode.

related_quests: Silk and Shadow: Help a former Shadowscale destroy a dangerous new group of assassins.
Pledge: Cradle of Shadows: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing the Cradle of Shadows.
summary: This article is about the enemy. For the set, see Velidreth (set). Velidreth, the Lady of Lace, is a grotesque Hoarvor Daedra who serves Mephala. She has been luring assassins to the Cradle of Shadows to create the Silken Ring, a group of assassins devoted to her mistress. She serves as the final boss of the dungeon. She is the only enemy that drops Distilled Slowsilver.
